heading: Accounts
unreachable: The mail server's management API is unreachable. Check that the server is running and the panel is configured.
name: Account
createHelp: The account is created on the mail server and can sign in at once.
nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64. It is the sign-in name and cannot be changed later.
addressesHelp: One per line. Each must be in a domain this server hosts.
passwordHelp: 12 to 64 characters. The server refuses a password found in a list of leaked ones.
createRefused: The mail server refused the account. The name or an address may already be in use, an address may be outside the hosted domains, or the password is in a list of leaked passwords.
createCap: This server has reached its account limit. Delete an account or raise the limit.
unavailable: The mail server did not answer. Nothing was changed.
nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting with a hyphen, up to 64 characters.
addressesInvalid: One of these is not an address.
deleteHelp: The account, its mailbox, its masked addresses and its app passwords are removed. This cannot be undone.
queueLegend: Mail this account still has queued to send
deletedLeft: Account {name} deleted. {count, plural, one {# queued message} other {# queued messages}} will still be delivered.
deleteGone: The account is no longer there, or it is declared in the configuration file and cannot be deleted from here.
passwordCharset: Use printable ASCII characters only: letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation.
displayNameControl: Remove the control characters and line breaks.
displayNameFormat: A name on one line, with no control characters.
